description: This file defines the MetricsReceiver class with static methods for logging various metrics related to VM and device events within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes standard headers and has licensing information, but no implementation details.

classes.name: MetricsReceiver
classes.description: A class providing static methods to log metrics for VM start, VM stop, device boot, and lock screen events.

methods.name: LogMetricsVMStart
methods.description: Logs metrics associated with the start of a VM.

methods.name: LogMetricsVMStop
methods.description: Logs metrics associated with the stopping of a VM.

methods.name: LogMetricsDeviceBoot
methods.description: Logs metrics related to device boot events.

methods.name: LogMetricsLockScreen
methods.description: Logs metrics related to lock screen events.
